**Finding**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

**Rollback**

- Verified: checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, **healthy**, error rate ~0.2%.

- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** titled "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0" with a full description of the failure, rollback steps, current state, and note that root cause of v2.3.1 is still under investigation. (The create call reported a timeout, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created, so the on-call engineer has been paged once.)

No policy-guarded deploys were needed — v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production, so the rollback proceeded directly.
